''See also: [[Netherclaw Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Netherclaw is a black-bladed [[sword]] used by [[Yerin]]. The weapon's name originates from mythological tales of a beast that acted as a guardian for the [[Netherworld]]. Originally intended for her [[Blood Shadow]], the [[sword]] was ultimately chosen because it better suited [[Yerin]]'s [[madra]]. The weapon possesses a unique [[binding]] that allows the user to activate a specific [[technique]]. When triggered, this [[technique]] forges massive, clawed hands or appendages made of [[blood and sword madra]]. These [[constructs]] can vary in [[scale]], appearing as large hands that can pin opponents to the ground or massive claws capable of crushing targets like a [[Tomb Hydra]]. The power of these forged claws is tied to the user's own strength and [[madra]], with their effectiveness increasing as the user advances in rank. While the [[technique]] is devastating, it can cause the [[sword]] to break down under intense use, requiring specialized methods like the [[Soulforge]] to repair.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Originally crafted to participate in combat between Archlord{{!}}Archlords, Netherclaw was a [[sword]] that had begun to break down. The weapon's [[binding]] is composed of claws forged from both [[blood and sword madra]]. During the activation of this [[binding]] by [[Yerin]], the entity began to boil with silver-and-scarlet [[madra]].}}
